# Research

**Generated files are not in git** (logs, `scoring_audit_*.md`, `copy_backtest/` exports, caches). See [docs/DATA_ARTIFACTS.md](../../docs/DATA_ARTIFACTS.md) for what to share via cloud storage and how to restore locally.

Live scoop logs: `live_scoop_logs/` (created by `infra/scripts/restart-live-scoop.ps1`).
